palette.entry.label: Ask the assistant…
palette.entry.description: Describe what you want to do in plain language
panel.inputPlaceholder: e.g. Set the stock of "Bolts 0193" in warehouse "Default" to 120
panel.expiresHint: This plan must be confirmed within 10 minutes.
panel.success: Done — the change has been applied.
panel.successWithErrors: Finished with some failures — see the breakdown below.
panel.failed: The assistant could not complete this request.
panel.unsupported: This request is not supported by the assistant.
panel.refused: You do not have the permission required for this action.
panel.providerError: The assistant service is currently unavailable. Your data has not been changed — please try again or use the regular admin screens.
panel.unseenNotice: A prompt you confirmed earlier has finished — open the assistant to see the result.
panel.inFlight: Another prompt is still being processed — wait for it to finish.
panel.bulkLimitExceeded: This prompt would affect more records than the configured limit ({limit}). Narrow the instruction and try again.
panel.planExpired: This plan has expired without confirmation. Submit the prompt again.
capability.disabled: The prompt assistant is disabled on this platform.
capability.notConfigured: The prompt assistant is not configured yet — set the provider and API key in Settings.
